statements.statement: Proposed warrant article to raise and appropriate an additional $350,000 for the FY27 school operating budget, to go to the Select Board for the November special town meeting.
The signed FY27 state budget included $418,056 more in education-specific receipts than the governor's original budget the town's budget was built on.
The Massachusetts FY2027 state budget included an additional $418,056 for Lunenburg Public Schools.
The town manager and Select Board will only support spending $350,000 of the $418,056 in new state education receipts on schools, leaving a $52,730 gap that stays with the town.
The unspent $52,730 would most likely end up in the town's free cash pool.
FY27 spending plan for the new state funds proposes increasing the high school assistant principal from 0.5 to 1.0 FTE at a cost of $90,450.
FY27 spending plan for the new state funds proposes $129,450 for 52 seats in the Ignite tutoring program.
School Committee voted (roll call: yes, no, yes, yes) to submit the $350,000 warrant article to the Select Board for the November special town meeting.
